XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault light comes on with car functioning correctly
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0130 | P0520 | P0132 | PROBE | LAMBDA | MOUNT | ON | LIGHTS UP | IGNITION | ON | YELLOW | YELLOW | MIL | CATALYST | EXHAUST | GAS | CONSUMES | HIGH | PETROL | OPERATION | CORRECT | NORMAL | REGNORMALLY |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Fuel injection

  • Device: Upstream lambda sensor

  • Fault: The vehicle’s engine fault light is illuminated, whilst the engine continues to run normally

  • Errors detected by the on-board diagnostics: One or more of the following:
    • P0130 (Lambda sensor 1, bank 1 – Fault)
    • P0131 (Lambda sensor 1, bank 1 – Low voltage)
    • P0520 (Engine oil pressure sensor – Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty lambda sensor upstream of the catalytic converter

• Action: Check the condition and correct functioning of the lambda probe and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is accessible from the engine compartment, halfway between the engine and the radiator, attached upstream of the catalytic converter. The faulty lambda sensor did not show any visual abnormalities.
